routes.description: No authentication required by the route itself. Answers 404 (as if it did not exist) while the server signs HS256, the default.

200.description: Success. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

404.description: Not found. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.

503.description: The key set is not available. The body is documented in docs/REMOTE_API.md.
